name: Retrieving the Past: Series One
source:
Jensen owns his own security company and has been too busy for and frankly not interested in the fairer sex. However lately he's felt different, more "aware" and definitely more sexually aware. He's also noticed women around him respond differently to him. Very openly showing their affection. He needs to find out why.

Journey with Jensen as he discovers lost memories, passion, lust and maybe something he's not really felt in a long, long time and that is love.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/mrknobb]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
延森擁有自己的保全公司，過去忙碌且對女性毫無興趣。然而最近他感覺自己變了，變得更「敏銳」，對性也明顯更感興趣。他還注意到周圍女性對他的回應發生改變，毫不掩飾地表達愛意。他必須查明原因。

與延森一同踏上旅程，看著他發現失去的記憶、激情、慾望，以及一種他已經很久沒有感受過的東西——愛情。

[來源：[url=https://www.patreon.com/mrknobb]Patreon[/url]]
